title: Changes in plasma IL-1β, TNF-α and IL-4 levels are involved in chemotherapy-related cognitive impairment in early-stage breast cancer patients
notes: N=190 BC. Pre/post-chemo. CICI in 38.4%. Higher IL-1β, TNF-α post-chemo → worse cognition. IL-4 decreased post-chemo. Paywalled - abstract-only extraction.
